title: Linux Fundamentals and System Administration
description: Introduces Linux operating system fundamentals and command-line tools used in software development, server administration, and application deployment. Students will learn filesystem navigation, file and directory management, file searching and log monitoring, permissions and ownership, process management, environment variables, networking basics, and secure remote access using SSH. The module emphasizes practical commands and troubleshooting skills for Linux-based development and production environments.

topics.title: Linux Fundamentals and File System Navigation
topics.description: Understand Linux, its directory structure, and the command-line interface. Learn to navigate the filesystem and inspect directories using essential commands.
subtopics: Introduction to Linux and its features
Linux distributions and common use cases
Introduction to the terminal and shell
Listing files and directories using ls

topics.title: Linux File and Directory Management Commands
topics.description: Learn to create, copy, move, rename, remove, and inspect files and directories using commonly used Linux commands.
subtopics: Copying files and directories using cp
Moving and renaming files using mv
Practical file and directory management exercises

topics.title: File Searching, Filtering and Log Monitoring
topics.description: Use Linux commands to locate files, search text, filter command output, and monitor log files. Learn to identify errors and inspect application logs.
subtopics: Searching files and directories using find
Monitoring live log updates using tail -f
Filtering application logs for errors and warnings

topics.title: Linux File Permissions and Ownership
topics.description: Understand Linux file security through permissions and ownership. Learn read, write, and execute permissions for users, groups, and others, and manage them using chmod and chown.
subtopics: Introduction to Linux users and groups
User, group, and others permission categories

topics.title: Linux Process Management, Logs and System Troubleshooting
topics.description: Learn to inspect and manage running processes and monitor system activity. Use process commands and application logs to identify resource usage, stop processes, and troubleshoot common Linux server issues.
subtopics: Process IDs (PID) and parent process IDs (PPID)

topics.title: Environment Variables, Networking and SSH Basics
topics.description: Understand environment variables and basic network communication in Linux. Learn to use curl for HTTP requests and SSH for securely connecting to remote Linux servers.
subtopics: Viewing variables using env and printenv
Setting and exporting variables using export
Understanding PATH and common environment variables
Using environment variables for application configuration
Making GET and POST requests using curl
Sending headers and request data using curl
Introduction to SSH and remote server access
